The following prospectus has been approved by the Financial Conduct Authority and is available for viewing:

Prospectus dated 4 September 2026 (the "Prospectus") relating to the CAD 20,000,000,000 Legislative Global Covered Bond Programme of National Bank of Canada ("NBC"), unconditionally and irrevocably guaranteed as to payments by NBC Covered Bond (Legislative) Guarantor Limited Partnership.

The Prospectus and documents incorporated by reference therein (to the extent not previously submitted) have been submitted to the National Storage Mechanism and will shortly be available for inspection at: https://data.fca.org.uk/#/nsm/nationalstoragemechanism. Certain of the documents incorporated by reference in the Prospectus have already been submitted to the National Storage Mechanism and are available for inspection at: https://data.fca.org.uk/#/nsm/nationalstoragemechanism.
To view the full Prospectus and the documents incorporated by reference therein, please paste the following URLs into the address bar of your browser.
Documents partially or entirely incorporated by reference in the Prospectus:
NBC's Annual Information Form dated 2 December 2025

NBC's Annual Report for the year ended 31 October 2025, including Management's Discussion and Analysis for the fiscal year ended 31 October 2025 and NBC's audited consolidated financial statements for the years ended 31 October 2025 and 2024, together with the notes thereto and the independent auditor's report thereon dated 2 December 2025

NBC's Third Quarter 2026 Report to Shareholders for the quarter ended 31 July 2026 which includes NBC's unaudited interim consolidated financial statements for the quarters ended 31 July 2026 and 2025

NBC's monthly Investor Report for the Calculation Date 31 July 2026.

Prior to relying on the information contained in the Prospectus you must ascertain from the Prospectus whether or not you are part of the intended addressees of the information contained therein.
